senses.en: A woman holding a baron's rank, or a baron's wife.

ex.en: The baroness welcomed visitors into her family's old castle.
ex.zh: 女男爵欢迎游客来到她家族的古堡。

ex.en: The portrait of the baroness illustrates how clothing once communicated social rank and wealth.
ex.zh: 这幅女男爵肖像展示了服饰过去如何传达社会地位和财富。

col: the title of baroness｜女男爵头衔
tip: 可指本人拥有爵位的女性，也可指男爵之妻。

senses.en: A huge landmass made of several continents joined together.

ex.en: Supercontinents form and break up over hundreds of millions of years.
ex.zh: 超大陆在数亿年间聚合又分裂。

senses.en: Magnetism preserved in ancient rocks, showing past positions of the poles.

ex.en: Paleomagnetism supported the theory of continental drift.
ex.zh: 古地磁学支持了大陆漂移学说。

senses.en: The ground at the bottom of the sea.

ex.en: New seafloor forms at mid-ocean ridges.
ex.zh: 新的海底在洋中脊形成。

senses.en: Relating to the deepest parts of the ocean.

ex.en: Abyssal plains are among the flattest places on Earth.
ex.zh: 深海平原是地球上最平坦的地方之一。

senses.en: an image in a shiny surface, or light bouncing back
careful thought about an experience or idea

ex.en: She caught her reflexion in the still pond.
ex.zh: 她在平静的池塘里看到了自己的倒影。

ex.en: Regular reflexion on classroom experiences can help teachers identify more effective ways to support individual learners.
ex.zh: 定期反思课堂经历可以帮助教师找到更有效的方法，为不同学习者提供支持。

tip: reflexion 是少用变体；考试写作宜用 reflection。

senses.en: An underwater mountain that does not reach the surface.

ex.en: Fish gather around the seamount.
ex.zh: 鱼群聚集在海山周围。

senses.en: A flat-topped underwater mountain.

ex.en: A guyot was once an island worn flat by waves.
ex.zh: 平顶海山曾是被海浪削平的岛屿。

senses.en: A ring-shaped coral island surrounding a lagoon.

ex.en: Darwin explained how atolls form.
ex.zh: 达尔文解释了环礁的形成。

senses.en: the ability to move from place to place

ex.en: Snakes use a special form of locomotion.
ex.zh: 蛇有特殊的移动方式。

ex.en: The shift from four-legged to two-legged locomotion freed early humans' hands for carrying tools.
ex.zh: 从四足转为两足行走，解放了早期人类的双手来携带工具。

tip: loco-（地方）+ motion。

senses.en: An area of shallow seawater separated from the sea by sand or coral.

ex.en: The calm lagoon is perfect for swimming.
ex.zh: 平静的潟湖很适合游泳。

senses.en: A long ridge of sand in a river or the sea.

ex.en: The boat got stuck on a sandbar.
ex.zh: 船搁浅在沙洲上。

senses.en: A sand ridge connecting an island to the mainland.

ex.en: At low tide you can walk across the tombolo.
ex.zh: 退潮时可以走过连岛沙洲。

senses.en: A narrow piece of high land sticking out into the sea.

ex.en: A lighthouse stands on the headland.
ex.zh: 一座灯塔矗立在岬角上。

senses.zh: 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症
senses.en: A viral disease that can damage nerves and cause paralysis.

ex.en: The nurse explained how vaccination protects children against poliomyelitis.
ex.zh: 护士解释了接种疫苗如何保护儿童免患脊髓灰质炎。

ex.en: International vaccination programmes have greatly reduced poliomyelitis, although continued monitoring remains essential to prevent further outbreaks.
ex.zh: 国际疫苗接种计划大幅减少了脊髓灰质炎病例，但持续监测对于防止再次暴发仍至关重要。

col: vaccination against poliomyelitis｜预防脊髓灰质炎的疫苗接种
tip: 日常多用polio；虽俗称小儿麻痹症，成人也可感染。

senses.en: A small curved bay.

ex.en: Smugglers once hid in the cove.
ex.zh: 走私者曾躲在小海湾里。

senses.en: A narrow strip of land joining two larger areas.

ex.en: The Isthmus of Panama joins two continents.
ex.zh: 巴拿马地峡连接两个大陆。

senses.en: A very small island.

ex.en: Seabirds nest on the rocky islet.
ex.zh: 海鸟在岩石小岛上筑巢。

senses.en: To regard someone or something with deep respect.

ex.en: People here venerate the elder who founded this school.
ex.zh: 这里的人们十分敬仰创办这所学校的长者。

ex.en: Many societies venerate historic buildings because they represent shared cultural achievements and a connection with the past.
ex.zh: 许多社会十分尊崇历史建筑，因为它们代表着共同的文化成就以及与过去的联系。

col: venerate as a hero｜尊为英雄
tip: 正式用词，比respect语气强；后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: A shallow area in water; a large group of fish.

ex.en: Ships avoid the dangerous shoals.
ex.zh: 船只避开危险的浅滩。

senses.en: Relating to the area between high and low tide.

ex.en: Intertidal creatures survive both air and water.
ex.zh: 潮间带生物能在空气和水中生存。

senses.en: Moving along the shore.

ex.en: Longshore drift moves sand along the beach.
ex.zh: 沿岸漂移使沙沿海滩移动。

senses.en: Relating to the shore of a sea or lake.

ex.en: The littoral zone is rich in life.
ex.zh: 沿岸带生物丰富。

senses.en: Requiring an exceptionally large amount of strength or effort.

ex.en: Moving that enormous sofa upstairs was a herculean task.
ex.zh: 把那张巨大的沙发搬上楼真是一项艰巨的任务。

ex.en: Restoring transport networks after widespread flooding requires a herculean effort from engineers, local authorities and volunteers.
ex.zh: 大范围洪灾后恢复交通网络，需要工程师、地方政府和志愿者付出极大的努力。

tip: 源于大力神Hercules；也常写作Herculean。

senses.en: Relating to an estuary.

ex.en: Estuarine waters mix salt and fresh water.
ex.zh: 河口水域咸淡水交汇。

senses.en: The settling of particles to the bottom of a liquid or body of water.

ex.en: Sedimentation slowly fills lakes.
ex.zh: 沉积作用慢慢填满湖泊。

senses.en: The process by which sediment turns into rock.

ex.en: Lithification takes millions of years.
ex.zh: 岩化作用需要数百万年。

senses.en: Repeated movement backwards and forwards around a central position.
Repeated change between different values, states, or opinions.

ex.en: We watched the slow oscillation of the clock's pendulum.
ex.zh: 我们看着钟摆缓缓地来回摆动。

ex.en: Regular oscillations in ocean temperatures can influence rainfall patterns and agricultural productivity across large regions.
ex.zh: 海洋温度的周期性波动会影响广大地区的降雨规律和农业生产力。

tip: 既指物体往复运动，也指数值或观点的反复变化。

senses.en: Pressing something so that it becomes denser.

ex.en: Compaction squeezes water out of sediment.
ex.zh: 压实作用把水从沉积物中挤出。

senses.en: The binding of sediment grains by minerals.

ex.en: Cementation glues sand grains into sandstone.
ex.zh: 胶结作用把沙粒粘成砂岩。

senses.en: The physical and chemical changes in sediment after it is deposited.

ex.en: Diagenesis can alter fossils.
ex.zh: 成岩作用可能改变化石。

senses.en: The process of becoming a fossil.

ex.en: Fossilization requires rapid burial.
ex.zh: 化石形成需要迅速掩埋。

senses.en: A person's face or facial expression.
To accept or approve of something.

ex.en: Her calm countenance reassured the children during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，她镇定的神情让孩子们安心。

ex.en: Governments should not countenance discriminatory practices that prevent qualified candidates from accessing employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府不应容许妨碍合格求职者获得就业机会的歧视性做法。

tip: 名词较文学化；动词常用于否定句，意为容许。

senses.en: Turning organic material into stone.

ex.en: Petrification preserved the tree's rings.
ex.zh: 石化作用保留了树木的年轮。

senses.en: Turned into stone; extremely frightened.

ex.en: The petrified forest is millions of years old.
ex.zh: 这片石化林有数百万年历史。

senses.en: Containing fossils.

ex.en: Fossiliferous limestone is full of shells.
ex.zh: 含化石的石灰岩里满是贝壳。

senses.en: Relating to measuring age using radioactive decay.

ex.en: Radiometric dating shows the rock is 4 billion years old.
ex.zh: 放射性测年显示这块岩石有40亿年历史。

senses.en: a special right belonging to a particular person or group

ex.en: Choosing the final design is the team leader's prerogative.
ex.zh: 选定最终设计方案是组长的专有权利。

ex.en: Decisions about public spending should not be the exclusive prerogative of a small group of officials.
ex.zh: 公共支出的决策不应成为少数官员独享的特权。

tip: 指特定身份享有的权利，不是人人都有的普通权利。

senses.en: The science of determining the age of rocks.

ex.en: Geochronology dates the layers precisely.
ex.zh: 地质年代学能精确测定岩层年代。

senses.en: The largest division of geological time; an extremely long period.

ex.en: The Precambrian spans several eons.
ex.zh: 前寒武纪跨越了几个宙。

senses.en: Relating to the earliest part of Earth's history, before about 540 million years ago.

ex.en: Precambrian rocks contain few fossils.
ex.zh: 前寒武纪岩石中化石很少。

senses.en: Waste material separated from metal during smelting

ex.en: Dark heaps of slag stood beside the old factory.
ex.zh: 旧工厂旁堆着一堆堆黑色的炉渣。

ex.en: Reusing slag in road construction can reduce industrial waste and demand for newly quarried materials.
ex.zh: 在道路建设中重新利用矿渣，可以减少工业废料及对新开采材料的需求。

tip: 工业义通常不可数；另有侮辱女性的英式俚语义，勿用。
note: 另有侮辱女性的英式俚语义；此处仅收工业义。

senses.en: The era from about 540 to 250 million years ago.

ex.en: Fish and land plants appeared in the Paleozoic.
ex.zh: 鱼类和陆生植物出现在古生代。

senses.en: The era of the dinosaurs, about 250 to 66 million years ago.

ex.en: The Mesozoic is called the age of reptiles.
ex.zh: 中生代被称为爬行动物时代。

senses.en: The era from 66 million years ago to the present.

ex.en: Mammals spread widely in the Cenozoic.
ex.zh: 哺乳动物在新生代广泛分布。

senses.en: The period about 540 to 485 million years ago, when many animal groups appeared.

ex.en: The Cambrian explosion produced most animal body plans.
ex.zh: 寒武纪大爆发产生了大多数动物的身体构型。

senses.en: A water channel with a gate that controls flow.
To wash something with a strong flow of water.
To flow quickly and in large amounts.

ex.en: We sluiced the mud off our boots outside.
ex.zh: 我们在外面用水冲掉了靴子上的泥。

ex.en: Engineers opened the sluice to release excess water and reduce pressure on the reservoir walls.
ex.zh: 工程师打开水闸排出多余的水，以减轻水库坝壁承受的压力。

col: sluice down the floor｜用水冲洗地面
tip: 作动词可指冲洗；sluice gate指控制水流的闸门。

senses.en: The period about 200 to 145 million years ago.

ex.en: Giant dinosaurs roamed during the Jurassic.
ex.zh: 巨型恐龙在侏罗纪漫游。

senses.en: The period about 145 to 66 million years ago.

ex.en: The Cretaceous ended with a mass extinction.
ex.zh: 白垩纪以一次大灭绝告终。

senses.en: The period about 250 to 200 million years ago.

ex.en: The first dinosaurs appeared in the Triassic.
ex.zh: 第一批恐龙出现在三叠纪。

senses.en: An older term for psychological difficulties involving anxiety or distress.

ex.en: The old psychology book devoted a chapter to neurosis.
ex.zh: 那本旧心理学书用一章的篇幅介绍神经症。

ex.en: Although neurosis appears frequently in older research, modern clinicians generally use more specific diagnostic terms.
ex.zh: 尽管神经症一词常见于早期研究，现代临床医生通常采用更具体的诊断术语。

tip: 旧心理学术语，不等于神经衰弱；复数为neuroses。

senses.en: The epoch of the Ice Ages, about 2.6 million to 11,700 years ago.

ex.en: Mammoths lived in the Pleistocene.
ex.zh: 猛犸象生活在更新世。

senses.en: The present geological epoch, since the end of the last Ice Age.

ex.en: Farming began early in the Holocene.
ex.zh: 农业始于全新世早期。

senses.en: The current geological period, covering the last 2.6 million years.

ex.en: Quaternary deposits cover much of the region.
ex.zh: 第四纪沉积物覆盖了该地区大部分地方。

senses.en: A proposed epoch defined by human impact on the earth.

ex.en: Some scientists say we live in the Anthropocene.
ex.zh: 一些科学家说我们生活在人类世。

senses.en: relating to the later Stone Age, when farming began

ex.en: The museum has neolithic tools.
ex.zh: 博物馆藏有新石器时代的工具。

ex.en: The Neolithic period saw the spread of farming, permanent villages and polished stone tools.
ex.zh: 新石器时代见证了农业、定居村落和磨制石器的传播。

tip: neo-（新）+ lithic（石）；Paleolithic 旧石器时代。

senses.en: A warm period between ice ages.

ex.en: We are living in an interglacial period.
ex.zh: 我们正生活在间冰期。

senses.en: The climate of a past geological age.

ex.en: Ice cores reveal the paleoclimate.
ex.zh: 冰芯揭示了古气候。

senses.en: A scientist who studies fossils.

ex.en: The paleontologist found a new dinosaur.
ex.zh: 这位古生物学家发现了一种新恐龙。

senses.en: Arrange or style hair.

ex.en: She learned to hairdress by practising on a mannequin.
ex.zh: 她通过在人头模型上练习学会了做发型。

ex.en: People who learn to hairdress professionally may develop practical skills that support employment in local service industries.
ex.zh: 学习专业美发的人可以培养实用技能，从而在当地服务行业就业。

tip: 日常说做发型用 style hair；美发行业用 hairdressing。
note: 罕见动词，不宜作常用名词；“美发”通常用 hairdressing。

senses.en: Dating events by studying tree rings.

ex.en: Dendrochronology dated the old beams to 1410.
ex.zh: 树木年代学测定这些旧梁木出自1410年。

senses.en: A pair of thin sediment layers deposited in a lake in one year.

ex.en: Counting varves gives the lake's age.
ex.zh: 数纹泥层可以得出湖泊的年龄。

senses.en: The study of water on and under the earth's surface.

ex.en: Hydrology helps predict floods.
ex.zh: 水文学有助于预测洪水。

senses.en: A scientist who studies water and its movement.

ex.en: Hydrologists measured the river's flow.
ex.zh: 水文学家测量了河流的流量。

senses.en: impossible to take away or transfer to someone else

ex.en: Our teacher explained why everyone has certain inalienable rights.
ex.zh: 老师解释了为什么每个人都享有某些不可剥夺的权利。

ex.en: Access to basic education should be recognised as an inalienable right, regardless of a child's background.
ex.zh: 无论儿童的背景如何，接受基础教育都应被承认为不可剥夺的权利。

col: an inalienable right to freedom｜不可剥夺的自由权
tip: 正式用语，主要修饰rights，强调不能剥夺或转让。

senses.en: Relating to water and its movement.

ex.en: The hydrological cycle moves water around the planet.
ex.zh: 水循环使水在全球流动。

senses.en: All the water on Earth, including oceans, lakes, ice and vapor.

ex.en: The oceans hold most of the hydrosphere.
ex.zh: 海洋拥有水圈的大部分。

senses.en: The lowest layer of the atmosphere, where weather happens.

ex.en: Clouds form in the troposphere.
ex.zh: 云在对流层中形成。

senses.en: the weight of packaging or a container without its contents
adjust a scale to exclude the weight of a container

ex.en: Tare the scale before adding flour to the bowl.
ex.zh: 往碗里加面粉前，先把秤去皮归零。

ex.en: Accurate tare measurements allow food producers to calculate product weight without including the packaging.
ex.zh: 准确测量皮重，能让食品生产商计算不含包装的产品重量。

col: tare the scale｜将秤去皮归零
tip: 皮重是容器重量；净重等于毛重减去皮重。

senses.en: The layer of the atmosphere above the troposphere, containing the ozone layer.

ex.en: Jets fly in the lower stratosphere.
ex.zh: 喷气式飞机在平流层底部飞行。

senses.en: The layer of the atmosphere above the stratosphere, where meteors burn up.

ex.en: Meteors burn up in the mesosphere.
ex.zh: 流星在中间层燃尽。

senses.en: A high layer of the atmosphere where temperatures are very high.

ex.en: The space station orbits in the thermosphere.
ex.zh: 空间站在热层中运行。

senses.en: The outermost layer of the atmosphere.

ex.en: The exosphere fades into space.
ex.zh: 外逸层逐渐融入太空。

senses.en: A solid block of metal cast for storage or processing.

ex.en: The worker lifted a shiny ingot with heavy tongs.
ex.zh: 工人用沉重的钳子夹起了一块闪亮的金属锭。

ex.en: Recycled aluminium can be cast into ingots before being processed into components for vehicles and buildings.
ex.zh: 回收铝可以先铸成锭，再加工成车辆和建筑所需的部件。

tip: 指铸成块的金属，不专指铁或纯铁。

senses.en: The boundary between the troposphere and the stratosphere.

ex.en: Storm clouds flatten at the tropopause.
ex.zh: 风暴云在对流层顶处变平。

senses.en: Winds that blow from the west in middle latitudes.

ex.en: Ships used the westerlies to cross the Atlantic.
ex.zh: 船只借西风带横渡大西洋。

senses.en: A calm area near the equator; a state of inactivity.

ex.en: Sailing ships were stuck in the doldrums for weeks.
ex.zh: 帆船在赤道无风带被困了几周。

senses.en: A seasonal wind bringing heavy rain, especially in South Asia.

ex.en: Farmers depend on the monsoon rains.
ex.zh: 农民依赖季风降雨。

senses.en: containing a promise, especially a written promise to pay

ex.en: She signed a promissory note before borrowing the money.
ex.zh: 她借钱前签署了一张本票。

ex.en: A promissory note provides written evidence of debt, helping lenders establish their legal right to repayment.
ex.zh: 本票提供书面的债务凭证，帮助出借人确立依法获得偿还的权利。

tip: 主要用于法律金融语境，常见搭配为promissory note。

senses.en: A violent storm with winds rotating around a low-pressure center.

ex.en: The cyclone flooded the coast.
ex.zh: 气旋淹没了海岸。

senses.en: An area of high pressure bringing calm, settled weather.

ex.en: An anticyclone brought a week of sunshine.
ex.zh: 反气旋带来了一周的晴天。

senses.en: Relating to rotating storms or low-pressure systems.

ex.en: Cyclonic winds spiral inward.
ex.zh: 气旋风向内旋转。

senses.en: Caring mainly about money rather than other considerations
A soldier paid to fight for a foreign army or group

ex.en: His mercenary attitude spoiled our plans for the charity.
ex.zh: 他唯利是图的态度破坏了我们的慈善计划。

ex.en: A purely mercenary approach to healthcare risks placing financial returns above the needs of patients.
ex.zh: 对医疗服务采取纯粹逐利的做法，可能会使经济回报凌驾于患者需求之上。

tip: 形容词带贬义，强调只看重金钱；作名词指雇佣兵。

senses.en: A line on a weather map joining places of equal air pressure.

ex.en: Closely spaced isobars mean strong winds.
ex.zh: 等压线密集意味着风力强。

senses.en: Relating to air pressure.

ex.en: A drop in barometric pressure signals a storm.
ex.zh: 气压下降预示着风暴。

senses.en: The process of a gas turning into a liquid.

ex.en: Condensation forms clouds.
ex.zh: 凝结形成云。

senses.en: Water lost from land through evaporation and plant transpiration.

ex.en: Evapotranspiration is high in hot weather.
ex.zh: 炎热天气下蒸散量大。

senses.en: Acting as though you are better than other people.

ex.en: The customer gave the waiter a haughty look.
ex.zh: 那位顾客傲慢地看了服务员一眼。

ex.en: A haughty attitude among senior managers can discourage employees from sharing ideas and reporting problems openly.
ex.zh: 高层管理者的傲慢态度会使员工不愿分享想法或公开反映问题。

tip: 含贬义，强调自视高人一等，不等于自信。

senses.en: A mixture of rain and snow.

ex.en: Sleet made the roads slippery.
ex.zh: 雨夹雪使道路湿滑。

senses.en: Light, fine rain.

ex.en: A cold drizzle fell all morning.
ex.zh: 冷冷的毛毛雨下了一上午。

senses.en: Falling or flowing very fast and heavily.

ex.en: Torrential rain caused landslides.
ex.zh: 倾盆大雨引发了山体滑坡。

senses.en: To sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way.
To hang loosely, especially the head or tongue.

ex.en: We lolled on the sofa after our long walk.
ex.zh: 长途散步后，我们懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。

ex.en: Comfortable public seating encourages visitors to loll in the shade rather than leave parks during hot weather.
ex.zh: 舒适的公共座椅让游客在炎热天气里愿意懒散地靠坐在树荫下，而不是离开公园。

col: loll on the sofa｜懒洋洋地躺在沙发上
tongue lolling out｜舌头耷拉在外
tip: 常接about或around，强调姿势松散、懒洋洋。

senses.en: Snow that builds up on the ground over winter.

ex.en: The snowpack feeds rivers in spring.
ex.zh: 积雪在春天为河流补给水源。

senses.en: Water from melting snow or ice.

ex.en: Meltwater swells the rivers each spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天融水使河流上涨。

senses.en: Water soaking into the ground; secretly entering a place or group.

ex.en: Paved surfaces reduce infiltration of rain.
ex.zh: 铺砌的地面减少了雨水下渗。

senses.en: The slow passing of a liquid through a porous material.

ex.en: Percolation through sand cleans the water.
ex.zh: 通过沙层的渗滤能净化水。

senses.en: The choice and style of words in speech or writing.
The way someone pronounces words, especially how clearly.

ex.en: Her formal diction sounded strange at our relaxed picnic.
ex.zh: 在我们轻松的野餐聚会上，她正式的措辞听起来很不协调。

ex.en: Writers often adapt their diction to make complex scientific ideas accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 作者常会调整措辞，让更广泛的读者能够理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: 既可指用词风格，也可指吐字是否清晰。

senses.en: The amount of space between grains in a rock or soil.

ex.en: High porosity lets rock hold more water.
ex.zh: 高孔隙度让岩石能储存更多水。

senses.en: How easily liquid can pass through a material.

ex.en: Clay has very low permeability.
ex.zh: 黏土的渗透性很低。

senses.en: Not allowing liquid to pass through.

ex.en: An impermeable layer of clay traps the water.
ex.zh: 一层不透水的黏土把水封住了。
